messages:
anna_docs: Heads-up: PR #4827 (migration guide for model-routing) is failing docs CI -- linkcheck + vale. Need reviewers and a merge slot. CI preview blocked by quota. details below.
ci-bot: linkcheck FAILED: 3 broken links. vale WARN: 5 rules flagged. preview build queued (quota reached).
anna_docs: Broken links are from old internal example URLs and a stray relative path. I can push a quick fix if someone can approve asap.
sophia_devex: I can review this morning (PST). @omar_eng can you look at the SDK snippet change? It touches python/usage.md and the code output.
omar_eng: On it. I'll run mkdocs locally and mimic linkcheck: `mkdocs build && python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && linkchecker docs/site`
julia_product: FYI this migration guide is targeted for next week's release train — let's not merge until Wednesday unless we can feature-flag the change.
anna_docs: Noted. If preview quota is blocking, can someone free a slot or merge to staging with the `docs-preview=off` label? (I know that's contentious)
mike_sre: We have one preview slot freeing at ~1901234600 UTC, can retigger then. Recommend fixing the two markdown link anchors first: one uses `#overview` but the header is `Overview:` (colon) so the anchor doesn't match.
omar_eng: Found vale errors: `Passive voice` and `Clichés` flagged in the intro paragraph. I'll reword and push. Also replacing `https://internal.redwood.local/model-routes` with `https://redwood.inference/docs/model-routing`.
anna_docs: Thanks @omar_eng. Pushed fixes in a small commit. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827/files
ci-bot: Preview build succeeded at 1901234615. linkcheck: 0 errors. vale: 2 warnings (style guidance).
sophia_devex: Reviewed and left two inline comments about the snippet output (minor). Approving after those are addressed. :thumbsup:
omar_eng: Addressed output formatting. Removed the `==>` arrows from the code block and normalized trailing whitespace. Pushed.
anna_docs: Ok sounds good. @julia_product can we merge Wednesday 09:00 UTC? That fits the release calendar and gives time to catch any regressions.
julia_product: Yes that's fine. Please add a short changelog note and set the merge time in the PR description. I'll watch for regressions.
anna_docs: Merge scheduled for 1901235040. Thanks all — will bump to staging then prod next week.
